name: ayesha/whatsapp-form
title: WhatsApp quote form
description: A short form (name, phone, service, preferred date, message). One click saves the request under Enquiries, emails it to the address in Settings → Business Info, then opens WhatsApp with the message ready for the customer to send to your WhatsApp number. Change the words in the sidebar.

hintPhone.default: Bahrain: 8 digits, e.g. 3xxx xxxx. Other countries: start with the country code, e.g. +966.

hintMessage.default: Optional. For example what you are moving, from where to where, and when.

note.default: We also get your request by email. WhatsApp opens with your message ready: press Send there.
